title: Visigenesis ground manifest
description: What engine/terrain/ground.js groundBundle() states about the ground it baked: the grid, the stored field's exact extremes, and FNV-1a hashes over the field and the masks derived from it. Two manifests with equal hashes describe the same ground bit for bit. Stage timings are informational and are not part of any hash.
$comment: Version 1. Constraints a schema cannot state, and tests/ground.test.js checks instead: min <= max; cellSize == size / (res - 1); every hash equals the matching line of canonicalTerrainFingerprint for the same field.

version.description: The manifest's own shape. Bumped when a field is added, removed or redefined.

generatorVersion.description: engine/terrain/fingerprint.js GENERATOR_VERSION: which terrain pipeline baked the field.

res.description: Samples per edge of the square field (canonically 513).

min.description: The lowest STORED (float32) height, in metres.

max.description: The highest STORED (float32) height, in metres.

waterLevel.description: The level, in metres, the sea was flooded from when the land mask was derived.

parameterHash.description: terrainParameterHash(params): every parameter that can move the ground.

heightHash.description: FNV-1a over the field's float32 bytes (little-endian).

landMaskHash.description: FNV-1a over the sea-connected wet mask, one byte per cell.

flowMaskHash.description: FNV-1a over the flow mask, one byte per cell.

deltaHash.description: FNV-1a over the erosion delta's float32 bytes, or null when no erosion ran.

stages.description: The stages that ran, in the order they finished. 'erode' is present only when the simulation ran.

ms.description: Wall time of the stage, present only when the caller injected a clock. Never hashed.
